test_case_name: Accept Cookie Consent on Reward Page After Navigating from Main Page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' button on the main page to accept cookies.
Click 'Acconsento' button on the Reward page to accept cookies.
And then check that the cookie consent banner is dismissed on the Reward page.
